what: Pre-registered protocol for S1 (scale the signed Redis webhook, POST /api/v2/events/payment, on one node)
registered_before: any measurement of the changed code; the baseline is run on the unchanged code in the same session
output: results/e2e_bench_s1.json (keys: baseline, repetitions, protocol, pass); results/e2e_bench.json is left as history

harness.client: closed loop, keep-alive HTTP/1.1 on loopback, one connection per concurrent client
harness.fresh_processes_per_repetition: new rusetect-server (and new redis-server in redis mode) for every repetition
harness.workload: 400 payers, 300 payees, timestamps one minute apart, every webhook event HMAC signed with a unique event_id (unchanged from results/e2e_bench.json)

metric: 200 responses per second (closed loop) and latency p50/p95/p99/max per level; the median of the 3 repetitions is reported next to all 3

correctness_gate.applies_to: redis-mode webhook, every level of every repetition; a level that fails it voids the run
checks: LLEN of live:ledger grew by exactly N (the ledger list is emptied after the warm-up, before the N measured requests)
resending 100 sampled events of the level returns 200 with Idempotent-Replayed: true, a body identical to the first response, and no ledger growth

pass_rule.primary: redis webhook at concurrency 32: median of 3 repetitions >= 3000 requests per second, median p99 < 50 ms, and the correctness gate green
pass_rule.stretch: reported either way: median >= 5000 requests per second with median p99 < 50 ms at any level <= 128
pass_rule.no_regression: memory-mode POST /api/v2/payment and memory-mode webhook: median requests per second at every level not more than 10% below the baseline median

deferred: group commit (change D) is not built; if the gate or the rule fails, the measured bottleneck is reported instead
scope: one shared 4 logical CPU container: load generator, server and redis-server share the CPUs; not the Vercel deployment
